scope: Live Kubernetes API admission for one case-owned, namespaced synthetic PSAExceptionRecord CRD. Compares one incomplete record before and after a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, checks each required declaration independently, and creates and updates one complete synthetic record. Fixture-created roles and impersonated identities verify exact-record writer and read-only access. A bounded snapshot reconciles one synthetic workload reference. Real API audit observes the targeted write bodies and Metadata-only reads and empty Secret creation. Deployed exception enforcement, approved policy choices, and audit retention require environment-specific evidence.
